dash.onboardTitle: Set up a survey with the wizard
dash.onboardSub: Purpose, questions, recipients and cadence in four steps

wizard.title: Set up the survey
wizard.skipTitle: Already know what you want to ask?
wizard.skipSub: Skip the wizard and write the questions yourself.
wizard.purpose: What do you want to find out?
wizard.countLabel: {count} questions · about {mins} min for the respondent
wizard.editLater: You can change each question afterwards in the builder.
wizard.importLater: — you can import more from CSV or Entra ID in the sending step.
wizard.noGroupsYet: No groups have been created yet — create them under Administration, or skip and choose recipients in the sending step.

builder.title: Title
builder.logicEmpty: No rules yet. Turn on “Follow-up on low score” on a scale question, or add a rule.
builder.anonBreach: A form field collects name or email — that breaks anonymity in this survey. Switch to “Named” under Send, or remove the field.
builder.lengthWarning: Long survey — the response rate falls
builder.followUpOn: Follow-up on a low score: on
builder.insertNote: New questions are added at the bottom. Change a scale question's style in the dropdown on its card.
builder.emptyQuestions: No questions yet. Add one from the panel on the right.
builder.readerNotice: You have read access and cannot change this survey.
builder.lockedNotice: This survey has been sent. The questions cannot be changed now — copy it as a new round to make changes.
builder.addDescScale: One type — pick the style afterwards: numbers, words, faces, 0–10 or a slider
builder.addDescDropdown: Long lists without taking up space
builder.addDescText: Their own words — put it last
builder.logicRule: A low score on “{question}” → the respondent gets a follow-up question

send.shareLinkNote: One link per survey — open until you close it.

results.title: Results
results.insufficient: Shown at five or more answers

reports.title: Reports
reports.groupThreshold: Groups with fewer than five answers are never broken out, regardless of filters.
reports.leaderScopeNote: Managers who get the link only see their own team. All employees see totals with no breakdowns.

admin.title: Administration
admin.groupThresholdNote: Groups under 5 people never get their own results
admin.roleNote: Administrators manage settings and privacy. Editors create and send surveys. Readers only see aggregated results — never individual answers.
admin.dsrDeadline: Deadline: 30 days after the request is received
admin.anonExplainer: Anonymous answers are stored with no link to a user. Results only appear at five answers, and free text is never shown with a group when the group is smaller than five. Nobody — not even an administrator — can look up who answered what.
admin.controllerNote: {company} is the data controller for the personal data. HeiTuva is the data processor and only processes data on instruction.
admin.companyNote: The organisation number and contact person are used in the data processing agreement and in the footer of the invitations respondents receive.
admin.controllerBody: {org} is the data controller for the personal data. HeiTuva is the data processor and processes data only on instruction.
admin.userCount: {active} active of {total, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}
admin.usersRoleNote: Administrator manages settings and privacy. Editor creates and sends surveys. Viewer sees only aggregated results — never individual answers.
admin.inviteFailed: Could not invite. Check the email address.
admin.pMinResponsesLocked: Always on — enforced in the database
admin.pIpLoggingDesc: Answers cannot then be traced back to a device
admin.pEuOnly: Store data only in the EU/EEA
admin.pAutoDeleteDesc: Free text and individual answers are removed after the retention period
admin.pConsentDesc: The respondent confirms what is stored
admin.retentionNoteNever: Raw data is never deleted automatically. Aggregated figures are kept.
admin.retentionNoteMonths: Raw data is deleted after {months} months. Aggregated figures are kept.
admin.dsrInnsynDesc: The respondent asks for a copy of what is stored
admin.dsrRettingDesc: Correct errors in name, email or group
admin.dsrSlettingDesc: Removes all identifiable data about the person
admin.dsrPortabilitetDesc: Export in a machine-readable format (JSON or CSV)
admin.docsComing: Document upload is coming in a later phase.
admin.oRemindersDesc: Follows the schedule you set per survey
admin.oAllowSelfServe: Let team leads create their own surveys
admin.oBrandMailDesc: Shown at the top of the invitation
admin.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
admin.errForbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
admin.errInvalid: Check the fields and try again.
admin.errDuplicate: That email address is already registered.
admin.errLastAdmin: At least one administrator must stay active.

profile.langNote: Choose the language you want to use in HeiTuva. Surveys you send can have their own language per recipient.
profile.roleNote: Your role is set by an administrator under Administration. Your mobile number is only used for notifications you have turned on yourself.
profile.nDigestDesc: Monday morning, with what needs action
profile.nLowRespDesc: When an active survey is below 50% after three days
profile.nSharedDesc: Reports and surveys others give me access to
profile.title: My profile
profile.emailReadOnly: Your work email is your sign-in address and is changed by an administrator.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
profile.sessionsNote: We show the session you are signed in with now. Full device list is coming.

library.title: Library
library.noteLovpalagt: These templates cover the survey duties in the Working Environment Act § 4-3, the activity and reporting duty in the Equality Act, the Transparency Act and sustainability reporting. They are a starting point — you must assess what is relevant for your organisation.
library.noteKunder: Customer templates use NPS, CSAT and ranking. Remember to enable "Offer follow-up" in the builder if customers should be able to ask for a reply.
library.templatesEmpty: No templates in this category yet.
library.bankNoDraft: You have no drafts yet — create a survey first.
library.readOnlyNote: Readers can browse the library but cannot create surveys or change templates.

auth.signInSub: Use your work email. We will send you a link.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox — we have sent you a link.
auth.mfaSub: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaRequired: Administrators must use two-factor. Set it up to continue.

onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.sub: You are signed in but not part of a company yet. Create one and you become its administrator.
onboarding.already: You already belong to a company.
onboarding.note: You become the administrator and can invite the rest of the team afterwards.

mfa.enrollSub: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
mfa.verifySub: Enter the six-digit code from your app.
mfa.enrollFailed: Could not turn on two-factor. Try again.
mfa.whyAdmin: Two-factor is required for administrators because the role controls privacy settings and data-subject requests.
mfa.unavailable: Two-factor is not enabled for this project. Contact whoever set it up.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.emptyAll: You have no surveys yet. Start from a template in the Library, or create a blank one.
surveys.shareSub: Co-editors can change questions and send. Results are always shared in aggregate — never individual answers.
surveys.shareNoCandidates: No other editors or administrators to share with yet.
surveys.scopeLeadDesc: Sees only their own team, never below five answers
surveys.scopeAllDesc: Sees the aggregate result with no breakdown
surveys.readerNotice: You have read access. You can view surveys but not change them.
surveys.actionFailed: That action could not be completed. Try again.
